newsitem.title: USA: WesterFed stake cut by Cramer group.
newsitem.headline: WesterFed stake cut by Cramer group.

text.p: A group led by New York investor James Carmer said Wednesday it cut its stake in WesterFed Financial Corp to 300,000 common shares or 6.8 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 100,000 common shares sold between December 27, 1996 and February 19, 1997 at prices ranging from $18.125 to $18.725 per share.
WesterFed, based in Missoula, Mont., is the holding company for Western Federal Savings Bank, an operator of 19 offices in Montana.
